title: The Ancient Ruins Part 2
content: Did you see it?! A hallway, Tan and made of bricks. Not wide enough to walk but enough to shimmy through. Each step along the path shows me cracks in the wall and webs on the ceilings. As I head forward, the black of the distance turns to red. The red is met with the sounds of chains. In the hall way, chains began to appear connected to the walls. The end of the Hallway approaches and I begin to hear high pitch roaring. Multiple hands and crawling was all I saw before running back to the entrance. Slapping hands on the walls, screaming getting closer. The feel of swiping and grabbing hands on my arms and legs. One touch, and one pull than suddenly I'm awake.
